summary: PR 615 is a verified partial optimization. It removes one redundant source-IR serialization, preserves cache and generated-IR identity in maintained RMSNorm and GEMM GPU checks, and accurately narrows its claim. It does not establish a general cold end-to-end speedup or fully resolve the original broad compile-time request.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: base rejects source_ir with TypeError.
Candidate regression and cache coverage; 20 tests passed.

tests.command: Three distinct fresh-cache runs per revision of measure_cold_jit.py rmsnorm
tests.what_was_measured: MI350X RMSNorm 16x4096 against a Torch reference. Base median wall/compiler 146.78/82.98 ms; candidate 147.34/83.59 ms; max absolute error 0.0009765625; identities unchanged.

tests.command: Three distinct fresh-cache runs per revision of measure_cold_jit.py gemm
tests.what_was_measured: MI350X GEMM 1024x1024x1024 against a Torch reference. Base median wall/compiler 720.08/233.18 ms; candidate 709.64/226.77 ms; max absolute error 0.4954681396484375 within maintained tolerance; identities unchanged.
Supplying retained source bypasses get_asm(enable_debug_info=False) and parses the supplied always-debug snapshot; maintained GPU outputs and final IR remained identical.

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) ran six fresh-cache executions per revision across maintained RMSNorm and GEMM, with independent Torch references and raw logs retained.
remaining_counterexamples: No general cold end-to-end speedup was demonstrated: RMSNorm median wall and compiler observations were slightly higher, while GEMM was lower, across only three isolated runs per revision.
Most compiler-pipeline time remains after removing one serialization, so the broad request to reduce FlyDSL compile time is not exhausted.
The exact issue-linked RMSNorm workload remains unverified: branch xiaobing/bench at 61e048653db47113c736afeb336851f98cc7c5c4 imports removed flydsl.expr.vector APIs and fails during import.
MI355 was unavailable; testing used MI350X in the same gfx950 family.

The candidate changes the parsed input from configuration-controlled debug printing to an always-debug retained snapshot; tested outputs were identical, but its unit regression does not cover this policy distinction.
remaining_limitations: The timing sample is deliberately small and does not support a statistically significant performance claim.
The reporter's exact external benchmark and MI355 hardware were unavailable.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes only Python JIT orchestration and contains no native source changes.
